messages:
Devon: FYI Customer Y asks for per-tenant EU-only canary + A/B variant comparison (v2 vs v2-quant) across 3 staged waves. Need quick decision: hosted regional canary vs dedicated offering. Pilot in 4 weeks.
Marta: Can we support both variants in a single canary? we can route traffic and split by tenant A/B weight, collect quality and latency.
Ethan: Yes, but qps & model footprint differ. v2-quant saves cost but might have subtle quality diffs. We'll need eval harness + perf gates.
Sana: Proposed rollout slices: Wave0: 1% EU tenants (A/B 50/50) for 24h; Wave1: 10% (A/B 70/30) for 48h; Wave2: 100% gradual over 5 days.
Priya: Customer requires data residency during canary (no PII leaving EU). Legal wants explicit language and logging. Sales: they will accept pilot fees.
Devon: Telemetry gates to progress waves: p95 latency <= baseline+100ms, 5xx rate <= baseline+0.1%, quality-regression < 2% on curated set, cost per 1k tokens delta. Autohold if any gate trips.
Marta: Fallbacks: 1) route affected tenants to v2-small (quant fallback), 2) route to cached prefix completions, 3) fallback to customers dedicated endpoint (if available). Need to quantify UX delta.
Ethan: Measured numbers: v2-quant p95 ~= baseline + 80ms, v2-small p95 ~= baseline + 220ms on long prompts. Prefix cache returns near-instant for known prefixes but degrades for novel prompts.
Sana: Flag schema draft:
```
{
  "flag": "tenant_region_ab_canary",
  "targets": {
    "region": "eu-central-1",
    "tenants": ["cust-y"]
  },
  "variants": [
    {"name":"v2","weight":50},
    {"name":"v2-quant","weight":50}
  ],
  "waves": [1,10,100],
  "gates": {
    "p95_latency_ms": 100,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.1,
    "quality_regression_pct": 2
  },
  "rollback": {"auto": true, "manual_kill": true}
}
```
Marta: Add metadata for owner (eng-infra), approvers list, and a link to eval set id. Also add a feature to restrict KV-cache persistence to EU nodes.
Devon: Ownership: eng-infra -> infra gates, eng-ml -> eval set + quality check, product -> go/no-go, CSE -> customer coordination. Document in runbook.
Priya: Prioritization ask: sales says this is strategic enterprise; they'll fund a small infra sprint. How many engineers do we need and for how long?
Ethan: Rough estimate: 2 infra engineers for 2 sprints to add region flagging, secret scoping, and deploy pipelines + 1 ML eng for eval harness.
Sana: Mitigations if infra sprint not approved: recommend Redwood Dedicated + provide a one-week integration support plan. Customer might prefer Hosted though.
release-bot: scheduled-deploy: eu-ab-canary at 2026-05-05T08:00Z, canary-duration: 72h, approvers: Devon, Marta, Ethan.
Devon: Next steps: Marta+Ethan to write runbook + gate playbook, Priya to lock MSA/legal wording, Sana to prepare eval prompts. Reconvene Tue 10am to finalize scope. :thumbsup:
